rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a device used to weigh people or things.

example.english: This scale is out of battery.
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 bong6 mou5 din6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for an abstract measurement or rating scale, such as a range from 1 to 10.

example.english: This questionnaire uses a scale from one to ten.
example.traditional: 呢份問卷採用一至十分嘅尺度。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 man6 gyun2 coi2 jung6 jat1 zi3 sap6 fan1 ge3 cek3 dou6

rows.note: Use this for the size, extent, or scope of an activity, project, or ambition.

example.english: The scale of this event is very large.
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 wut6 dung6 kwai1 mou4 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a musical scale made up of a sequence of notes.

example.english: This song uses a major scale.
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 jung6 zo2 daai6 diu6 jam1 gaai1
